An '''asteroid''' was located in the [[Crustai system/Legends|Crustai system]] on the edges of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. The [[Crustai asteroid base]] used by the [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] was hidden inside the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. The asteroid had passive [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] hidden on one side so that when it rotated the sensors would scan the whole area.<ref name="OBF" />
